name: product-analyst
description: Runs a virtual product team over any web solution — a local repo/folder, or a described live app — and produces one ranked top-10 list of what to build next: `product` for feature/end-user recommendations, `tech` for technical/hardening recommendations. Triage profiles the solution, three specialists (UX, technical, market) propose evidence-grounded candidate features in parallel, an independent validator cross-checks every candidate twice (blind to each other), and a lead reconciles both passes into the requested ranked top 10.
